question: Can goal-query prediction preserve teacher candidate decisions with less native scoring latency, and does projected plus tail have value beyond a matched scalar head?

source.commit_verification: declared archive provenance from prior frozen baseline; staged source directories have no .git, so fresh HEAD verification is unavailable; report actual source paths and runtime interface/cost checks separately
source.criterion: unmodified official terminal squared Euclidean cost

data.goal_donor_rule: own logged goal plus cyclic next three DIFFERENT parent-episode donor goals within the same split; train goal donors never enter development/test
data.goal_labels: derive every goal cost from the same detached teacher terminal target; no candidate-specific self-terminal goals
data.projection: rank32 PCA of training teacher terminal targets only, centered by training mean; no rank selection
data.insufficient_episode_policy: engineering INCONCLUSIVE; do not change slices after execution
data.dataset_scaler_boundary: existing teacher/dataset preprocessing retained; episode isolation does not imply globally untouched normalization statistics

models.trunk: goal-free LayerNorm(242), Linear(242,256), GELU, Linear(256,256), GELU; input current trusted latent plus entire H5 action sequence
models.goal_head: concat shared trunk with full 192D goal, Linear(448,256), GELU, Linear(256,1), softplus times frozen training cost scale
models.latent_heads: Linear(256,r or 192), residual over projected or full trusted current latent
models.scalar_aux: same direct scalar deployment head with identical projected-y and tail auxiliary heads/losses during training; discard auxiliary heads in native timing
models.projected_only: diagnostic using same projected_tail weights with tail set zero; not another training arm
models.oracle_y_learned_tail: diagnostic using exact teacher y with learned tail; teacher-paid, no deployment timing
models.exact_projected_only: teacher-paid diagnostic exact teacher projected terminal distance with tail zero; control for oracle_y_learned_tail; no training or timing

training.cost_loss: candidate-centered squared error divided by detached teacher bank variance clamped by training variance floor, plus 0.1 absolute squared error divided by fixed train RMS cost squared
training.variance_floor: max(global variance of all TRAIN query-cost labels times 1e-6, 1e-8); tail uses the same formula on TRAIN tail labels
training.loss_exact: L(a,t)=mean_context_goal(mean_candidate(((a-mean_candidate(a))-(t-mean_candidate(t)))^2)/max(mean_candidate((t-mean_candidate(t))^2),v_floor))+0.1*mean((a-t)^2)/max(mean_TRAIN(t^2),1e-8). Scalar: L(Jhat,J). Projected: L(Jhat,J)+mean((yhat-y)^2)/s_y2+L(ehat,e). Scalar_aux: L(directJ,J)+mean((auxy-y)^2)/s_y2+L(auxe,e). Full: L(Jhat,J)+mean((zhat-z)^2)/s_z2. All auxiliary weights are 1. s_y2/s_z2 are mean coordinate population variance of TRAIN projected/full terminal targets, clamped 1e-8.
training.projected_tail_loss: cost_loss + normalized projected latent MSE + centered-and-absolute tail_loss
training.scalar_aux_loss: same projected_tail auxiliaries and weights + direct scalar cost_loss
training.full_latent_loss: cost_loss + terminal latent MSE normalized by training target variance
training.budget_scope: two training seeds, no width/rank/loss sweep; feasibility screen, not a powered population study

timing.boundary: cached H1 trusted context and goal plus 300 normalized H5 packed action candidates to final scores
timing.bank_selection: first six distinct rows of each development/test split in frozen construction order, action-bank index0 and own goal; identical banks across arms and training seeds
timing.native_clock: CPU perf_counter elapsed with CUDA synchronization immediately before/after score; includes launch and Python overhead
timing.split_contract: measure development for selection, and independently measure final test for final gates
timing.teacher_implementation: reference official_teacher_targets: cached input H1 latent and goal, five official predict calls plus criterion; no within-rollout iteration-cache optimization, so not the strongest cached planner baseline

gates.integrity: finite training/output, disjoint parent episodes and goal sources, official cost equality, orthonormal projection and exact decomposition; failure is INCONCLUSIVE
gates.aggregation: predictor median/min quality thresholds use all individual context-anchor/action-seed/goal banks as descriptive engineering coverage checks; parent-episode medians determine paired tail/structural 6-of-8 signals. Banks are never treated as independent statistical replicates. Cyclic donor sharing introduces dependence even between episode summaries; no p-values or population CIs.
gates.tail_signal: oracle_y_learned_tail beats exact projected-only by median episode top30 >=0.05 and improves >=6/8 test parent episodes for both training seeds
gates.structural_signal: projected_tail beats scalar_aux by median episode top30 >=0.05 and improves >=6/8 episodes; Spearman drop <=0.02 and native p50 <=1.10 times scalar_aux, for both seeds
gates.advance: select one deployable arm on development only by top30 then Spearman then native latency, among arms meeting quality; freeze choice before final test. If chosen arm fails final predictor gate for either seed, STOP; no adaptive CEM or closed-loop escalation
gates.no_go_scope: this frozen recipe and training budget only, not all goal-query models
gates.adaptive_cem_if_pass: next bounded gate must preserve 300/30/top30 official argsort/unbiased std/candidate-zero; paired innovations and teacher shadow outside timing; first-action and native solve gates before closed-loop
gates.closed_loop: deferred until adaptive CEM gate passes; never infer success from predictor metrics
